title: AI Maintenance Copilot
summary: Exploring a faster way to turn voice notes and photos into structured maintenance records.
challenge: Maintenance documentation competes with hands-on work. The concept explores capturing observations in the moment and organizing them into a reviewable record.
constraints: Technician review before accepting a report
Clear separation of observations and hypotheses
A simple workflow that can be used during real work
approach: Start with the documentation workflow: capture, structure, review and export. Define a useful report format before selecting dedicated hardware.
development: The current work is problem definition and architecture exploration. Voice capture, photo handling and report generation are proposed features; a working dedicated device is not yet demonstrated.
validation: No verified time savings, diagnostic accuracy or production deployment results are available. The first proposed test compares manually written notes with a reviewed draft generated from the same observations.
outcome: A defined research direction for a maintenance documentation assistant. The project remains in research.
next: Measure editing time and missing information
Decide whether dedicated hardware adds value
linkedin: I'm exploring a maintenance documentation assistant that turns observations into structured, reviewable records. The project is in research: the next step is to test the capture-and-review workflow before building dedicated hardware.

cover.alt: concept illustration: Rugged maintenance capture-device concept beside a motor and report tablet.

title: JAKS ServiceLoop

challenge: A workshop needs a simple way for a customer to revisit service information and contact the business after a visit.
constraints: Make the link useful without installing an app
Validate a real workshop workflow before scaling
approach: Explore a customer-facing service page linked from an NFC tag or QR code, with a separate workflow for updating workshop information.
development: Early web-interface work and feature definition cover service dates, mileage, contact actions and possible loyalty features. The full operational workflow and access controls still need validation.
validation: No live customer adoption, retention uplift or recurring revenue is claimed. Authentication, data handling and workshop testing remain open work.
outcome: An independent product direction under development, not a released subscription platform.
next: Validate staff access and data handling
Run a limited pilot with explicit consent
linkedin: JAKS ServiceLoop explores how an NFC or QR touchpoint could keep workshop service information accessible. It is in development; the next milestone is a small workshop workflow test, not a revenue claim.
